contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return whether text starts with the exact literal needle, case-sensitively. An empty needle always matches. Do not interpret regular-expression characters.
contract.domain: Strings are Unicode text of at most 128 code points. Lone surrogate code units are excluded.
contract.outputRole: whether source starts with the required beginning
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
